verdict.rationale: Hightouch's official MCP server lets users build audiences, manage and create syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance "all in plain language." The docs include concrete natural-language prompts for audience-plus-sync creation and campaign analysis. A built-in agent also lets users explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works as documented, and evidence that the in-app built-in agent goes beyond exploration and analysis (full operation is shown only through an external AI assistant via MCP).
